anchor_policy: Exact SPID with valid historical price: preserve observed relative premium.
Missing price with known original season: use fitted model, with explicit uncertainty.
Custom seasons or ratings outside training range: flag and calibrate; do not silently treat as an ordinary historical season.
trade_policy_proposal: NPC styles have differing reservation values; finite wallets/cards and completed peer trades determine supply/demand, never synthetic random quote ticks.
pending: Choose current-server currency calibration before installing.
Implement persistent finite NPC wallets, holdings, listings and peer settlement after value-model review.
Backtest high-rare and new custom seasons separately.
